answer: Each identity carries one key-bound ledger of its own verified jobs, and trust extends only as far as its horizon of elapsed tenure: one epoch of real work buys one epoch of standing, never more. A new claim is admitted only through a single inlet that checks the ledger's chain, and a break in that chain burns the identity's entire garden of standing back to zero. Ten fakes therefore owe ten separate ledgers grown over ten epochs each, and no ledger, garden, or inlet check can be pooled or reused across clones.
